text:
jeff: Quick sync — noticed a perf regression on p99 for continuous-batcher after the kernel selector tweak. Need dashboard signals to catch these earlier. TL;DR: add QoS-oriented panels: queued_token_budget, batch_fill_pct distribution, kernel_choice by latency, kvcache_warmup_rate.

anita: where was the regression observed?

jeff: prod-dedicated us-east, model=vicuna-13b-8k-quant. p99 token latency jumped from ~120ms -> ~280ms around 02:12 UTC last night.

sam: did the kernel selection change land in the same deploy window?

jeff: yes — we moved default kernel_strategy from `arch-agnostic` to `arch-aware`. Hypothesis: for many short-seq requests the kernel switch overhead + lowered kv-cache hit pattern caused extra tail latency.

mike: KV cache misses spiked too, I saw kvcache_miss_total up ~3x in the same timeframe. Suggested query: `sum(rate(kvcache_miss_total[1m])) by (pool)` — add that panel.

anita: proposal for dashboard panels (first pass):
  1) batch_fill_pct heatmap (bucketed by bin of fill% and sequence_length)
  2) queued_token_budget gauge + timeseries with alerting
  3) kernel_switch_rate timeseries + p99 latency overlay (per kernel)
  4) kvcache_hit_ratio and kvcache_warmup_rate
  5) tokens_per_sec and tokens_queued split by qos class

sarah: +1. For alerts: queued_token_budget > `200000` tokens sustained 5m => page; kernel_switch_rate spike (2x baseline) for 3m => page. Also add `tokens_per_sec` drop for a model by 30% for 10m => SRE ticket.

perf-bot: perf-regression-detect: p99_latency increase detected for vicuna-13b-8k-quant at 2026-03-17T02:12:34Z (delta +160ms, sig=0.98).

jeff: good signal. Also add a small table view that shows top callers by token share, last_seen kernel_choice, and kvcache_hit_ratio — helps triage if it's a skew from a noisy tenant.

anita: I'll sketch out queries and a dashboard JSON. Example panel snippet (Grafana-friendly) for queued_token_budget:
```json
{
  "type": "timeseries",
  "title": "queued_token_budget (global)",
  "expr": "sum(queued_token_budget)",
  "interval": "1m",
  "alerts": [{"expr": "sum(queued_token_budget) > 200000", "for": "5m"}]
}
```

mike: also add a "spillover" metric: number of requests routed to fallback/cheaper model because batch token budget exceeded. Query: `sum(rate(fallback_route_total[1m])) by (pool, model)` — that explains user-visible degrade.

sam: small instrumentation ask: have kernel selector emit a `kernel_choice` label and `kernel_switch_count` metric per request so we can correlate with latency. Also emit `batch_candidate_count` and `selected_batch_size` per batch.

jeff: plan: anita builds dashboard + rule PR, mike wires alerts and the spillover query, sam adds kernel selector labels & counters, I'll run a canary toggle to revert to `arch-agnostic` for short sequences during the experiment. Aim: EOW rollout with dashboards and alerting enabled.

anita: ack, I'll post PR with dashboard panels + PromQL snippets and link it here when ready.

mike: one more thing — add a small dashboard panel with PromQL example for tokens/sec: `sum(rate(tokens_emitted_total[1m])) by (model, qos)` so we can watch token throughput vs queued budget.

jeff: perfect. Thanks all :thumbsup: — if anyone sees weird kernel_choice labels in the next canary ping here.
